heading: Note: All fluid (CSF, pleural, ascetic, joint or pericardial) must be subjected to biochemical analysis (protein and glucose con- centrations), cell count, AFB stain and culture whenever possible.
data: Lymph node biopsy or fine needle aspiration
Miliary TB (e.g. disseminated) Chest radiograph and lumbar puncture (to test for meningitis)
Pleural effusion (older children and Chest radiograph, pleural tap for biochemical adolescents) analysis (protein and glucose concentrations), cell count and culture
Osteoarticular Radiograph of joint/bone, joint tap or synovial biopsy
